final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) as avg_diff FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) as baseline_value FROM status_avgs) SELECT sa.event_status, sa.avg_diff, sa.avg_diff - b.baseline_value as diff_from_baseline FROM status_avgs sa CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.baseline_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa.event_status
